driftDefinition: eas.driftCount = parameter_delta records (Sprints 1-18 convention; PactaSentinelGuard treats driftCount != 0 as drift); drift_rescans.drifted = re-scanned previously attested protocols (Part C) whose scored control plane changed since their pin
note: Staged, not yet indexed: tools/apply_sprint19_attestation.py --uid <Base EAS UID> --tx <tx> stamps base_eas_uid, moves these records into docs/api/v1/index.json and removes the two converted protocols from docs/api/v1/rpc-pinned.json.

records.surface: Level-1 governance payloads execute on Base through ExecutorLvl1 after a 1-day delay
records.onchain_observed: PayloadsController (0x2DC219E716793fb4b21548C0f009Ba3Af753ab01).getExecutorSettingsByAccessControl(1) = (ExecutorLvl1 0x9390B1735def18560c509E2d0bc090E9d6BA257a, 86400s); MIN_EXECUTION_DELAY() = 86400s, MAX_EXECUTION_DELAY() = 864000s; MESSAGE_ORIGINATOR() = Ethereum Governance V3 0x9AEE0B04504CeF83A65AC3f0e838D0593BCb2BC7 (ORIGIN_CHAIN_ID() = 1); access level 2 has no executor on Base. ExecutorLvl1 (owner() = the PayloadsController) is owner() and getACLAdmin() of PoolAddressesProvider 0xe20fCBdBfFC4Dd138cE8b2E6FBb6CB49777ad64D and holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and POOL_ADMIN on ACLManager 0x43955b0899Ab7232E3a454cf84AedD22Ad46FD33.
records.documented_reference: aave.com/docs (governance): 'compared with the 3-day vote and 1-day timelock of a Level 1 proposal'

records.surface: EMERGENCY_ADMIN (pause / unpause) = Aave Protocol Guardian 4-of-7 Safe
records.onchain_observed: Protocol Guardian Safe (0x56C1a4b54921DEA9A344967a8693C7E661D72968, v1.3.0): getThreshold() = 4 of 7 owners, the 7 signers listed in the docs; ACLManager 0x43955b0899Ab7232E3a454cf84AedD22Ad46FD33 hasRole(EMERGENCY_ADMIN, Safe) = true, hasRole(POOL_ADMIN, Safe) = false.
records.documented_reference: aave.com/docs (governance): 'The Protocol Emergency Guardian is a 4 of 7 multi-signature wallet consisting of the following signers:' and 'The Protocol Emergency Guardian holds the EMERGENCY_ ADMIN'; ACL Manager docs: 'Holders of this role can pause and unpause the pool or an individual reserve.'

records.surface: Both Base Comet markets are governed by the Ethereum Timelock through a bridge receiver and a 1-day local timelock
records.onchain_observed: BridgeReceiver (0x18281dfC4d00905DA1aaA6731414EABa843c468A).govTimelock() = Ethereum Timelock 0x6d903f6003cca6255D85CcA4D3B5E5146dC33925 (delay() = 172800s on Ethereum); localTimelock() = 0xCC3E7c85Bb0EE4f09380e041fee95a0caeDD4a02 (delay() = 86400s, admin() = the BridgeReceiver); governor() of cUSDbCv3 (0x9c4ec768c28520B50860ea7a15bd7213a9fF58bf) and cUSDCv3 (0xb125E6687d4313864e53df431d5425969c15Eb2F), owner() of CometProxyAdmin 0xbdE8F31D2DdDA895264e27DD990faB3DC87b372d and governor() of the Configurator 0x45939657d1CA34A8FA39A924B71D28Fe8431e581 are the local timelock.
records.documented_reference: docs.compound.finance (governance): 'The Timelock on Mainnet is the administrator of all community sanctioned instances of Compound III.' and 'Local Timelocks have an additional delay before Comet admin functions can be called via proposal execution.'

records.surface: Pause Guardian of both Base markets = 5-of-9 Safe with the Community Multi-Sig's owners
records.onchain_observed: cUSDbCv3 (0x9c4ec768c28520B50860ea7a15bd7213a9fF58bf) and cUSDCv3 (0xb125E6687d4313864e53df431d5425969c15Eb2F) pauseGuardian() = Safe 0x3cb4653F3B45F448D9100b118B75a1503281d2ee (5-of-9, v1.3.0), whose 9 owners equal, in order, those of the Ethereum Community Multi-Sig 0xbbf3f1421D886E9b2c5D716B5192aC998af2012c (5-of-9); no market is paused.
records.documented_reference: docs.compound.finance (governance): 'COMP token-holders designate the Pause Guardian address, which is held by the Community Multi-Sig' and 'The only addresses that are allowed to call this function are the Governor and the Pause Guardian.'

records.surface: River (LsETH) upgrade and admin Firewalls are administered by 4-of-7 Safes
records.onchain_observed: River (0x8c1BEd5b9a0928467c9B1341Da1D7BD5e10b6549) EIP-1967 admin slot = Firewall 0x3A5b4db174a3CC17d8cE40C5B04272737195151b, whose getAdmin() is Safe 0x8EE3fC0Bcd7B57429203751C5bE5fdf1AB8409f3 (4-of-7, v1.3.0, no modules); getAdmin() = Firewall 0xd745A68c705F5aa75DFf528540678288ed2aD9eE, whose getAdmin() is Safe 0xE3208Aa9d1186c1D1C8A5b76E794b2B68E6cb3a5 (4-of-7, the same 7 owners, no modules); the Firewall executor Safe 0xDE55C9dc78f985fE1502484Cb98EBfAB66A56B62 (2-of-3) may call pause() but not unpause() or upgradeTo(address). Implementation RiverV1 0x0056f9ed62dAa4dc3F972340C92326AcCddd1a9D (version() = 1.3.0).
records.documented_reference: docs.liquidcollective.io (ETH FAQs): 'An administrative multisig is made up of a variety of Liquid Collective ecosystem participants.'

records.surface: USDtb token administered by a single admin address with no timelock (issuer: Anchorage)
records.onchain_observed: USDtb (0xC139190F447e929f090Edeb554D95AbB8b18aC1C).owner() = 0xd93826BB299765c87D13AeBa2A7E5d9B27A03956 (no code), which also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and owns the ProxyAdmin 0x3C405F68d5C6eCE868e5646cAC926679839aCd68; implementation AnchorageTokenUSDtb 0x9D6d77a21702b9AFcF924983fbFB84AAAAe79589; MINTER_BURNER_ROLE, BLOCKLISTER_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE are each held by one address without code; the former Ethena admin Safe 0xe897D8620D5EbA2C8ecAAF0aDa191a23230aB8Ec no longer holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
records.documented_reference: ethena-labs/ethena-usdtb-contest README: 'controlled by a single admin address' and 'The admin address can change the state at any time, without a timelock.'; docs.ethena.fi: 'As of October 2025, USDtb is issued by Anchorage Digital Bank.'

records.documented_reference: docs.ethena.fi key addresses (Dev multisig): '5/11 signers.' and 'Owner of Ethena's deployed mainnet smart contracts & able to modify contract parameters.'
